label: Necessary existence by own nature versus accessible-world necessity
term: necessary existence by own nature versus accessible-world necessity
resolution: The sourced essential-existence statement distinguishes the explanation by an existent’s own nature from explanation by other natures. NecessaryAt only quantifies existence over accessible worlds. Neither a proof of that modal predicate nor a constant truth distribution by itself establishes own-nature explanation. No source fidelity or formal equivalence is inferred between these meanings; essential facts and instantiated concrete bearers remain distinct. The sourced sense NECESSARY_EXISTENCE_BY_OWN_NATURE_1 ('essential existence or existence grounded in the bearer's own essence') is an interpretation fork between two sibling analyst readings: NECESSARY_EXISTENCE_BY_OWN_NATURE_3, essence membership of the bearer's own existence fact (OwnEssentialExistence), and NECESSARY_EXISTENCE_BY_OWN_NATURE_4, explanation of that fact by the bearer's own intrinsic reason token (CandidateIntrinsicReason). Sense _1 is not formalized and may not be passed to _3 or _4 without stating which reading is meant. The passage _3 → _4 is an OPEN bridge: finite controls separate them in both directions, and under an existence PSR the _4 token can follow from excluding other reasons without any use of _3. Neither _3 nor _4 is defined by, or defines, the modal sense _2.
